header: THE SAMPLE LISTS OF THE BIRTHDAY AND RETIREMENT (SUPERANNUATION) TABS OF THE HOME PAGE: the five sample people of each list, with the photos kept in the project's public folder (public/Eleanor_Vance.jpeg and so on). They were the lists of the first version of the widget; I asked on 17 Nov 2026 for them back on those two tabs. The Silver Jubilee tab is not here: it still comes from the database. To show the real birthdays and retirements from the database again, set USE_SAMPLE_LISTS to false: nothing else changes (the API, the query and the hook are still in place and still feed the Silver Jubilee tab).
